flags.description: Browser-based selected-object versus mixed GP catalog close-approach screening

rollback.action: Set enabled to false, regenerate browser metadata, build and checksum a new artifact, run the release checks, and redeploy that disabled artifact.
rollback.dataImpact: None. Version 2.0 does not persist screening results or modify source catalog data.
rollback.fallback: Satellite visualization, selection, and catalog diagnostics remain available without screening.

flags.description: Authenticated durable server-side full-catalog close-approach screening

rollback.action: Stop new job admission, cancel active jobs, set this flag to false, regenerate release metadata, run the release checks, and restart the server.
rollback.dataImpact: Catalog snapshots and completed job history remain private and readable; no source catalog is modified.
rollback.fallback: The v2.0 browser selected-object screener and all visualization workflows remain available.
